page.notes: The decorative divider between the first paragraph and the title block is an ornament and is not transcribed. The initial R of "REBUS" is a large woodcut initial, joined to the word as the rule requires. Greek lines are copied as printed, including the lower-case iota in "ΔΙΚΑΣΤΗΡΙΩι". The Greek and Latin columns are parallel; the Greek column is given first. No marginal notes are printed. A dark stain runs down the right edge and is not transcribed.
